verdict.rationale: Honeybadger ships a native "Describe your search" panel that turns plain-language descriptions into error search queries. Its official hosted MCP server, with OAuth, lets an AI assistant handle project management, error investigation and BadgerQL queries from natural-language requests. Together these let a user operate core workflows conversationally. Missing for 10: in-product natural-language control beyond search (it otherwise relies on an external AI client), explicit documentation of natural-language write actions such as resolving or assigning errors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
